refused.name: an add signature with a spare bit set
an add signer with a spare bit set (the text names that spelling)

refusedNote: 1.48: each part's verifier refuses every case (key = the public key the text names, kind req or add); the server answers key_invalid (req) or add_invalid (add). Each verifies under a lenient verifier (node), so the refusal is the part's own canonical and low-s rule.

helloHash.name: a hello with no key: the token alone
a child's hello: token | k | r
a parent's hello: token | k | r

helloHashNote: 1.48 K2: QR h = b64u(SHA-256(UTF-8 t)) for a hello with no k; b64u(SHA-256(UTF-8 (t + "|" + k + "|" + r))) for one with k and r.
addNonceNote: 1.48 K1: a reply that carries an add carries pt with nonce = b64u(SHA-256(UTF-8 ("lbp2|" + id + "|" + b64u(SHA-256(the signer's 65 bytes))))); a reply with no add keeps plain = b64u(SHA-256(UTF-8 ("lbp2|" + id))).
